platform_info.name: Instagram
platform_info.description: Note that supported DDP language also includes Dutch and probably other languages as well. You get an english DDP regardless of the Dutch language setting. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: The accounts that follow you on Instagram. This network grew over time as people found your content.
description.nl: De accounts die u op Instagram volgen. Dit netwerk groeide in de loop van de tijd naarmate mensen uw content ontdekten.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one account that follows the participant on Instagram, including when they started following.

columns.Account: Username or display name of the follower account.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the follower's Instagram profile.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the account started following the participant.

title.en: Accounts that you follow on Instagram
title.nl: Accounts die je volgt op Instagram

description.en: The accounts you chose to follow. These reflect your interests and the communities you engage with.
description.nl: De accounts die u heeft gekozen te volgen. Deze weerspiegelen uw interesses en de gemeenschappen waarmee u zich bezighoudt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one account that the participant follows on Instagram, including when they started following.

columns.Account: Username or display name of the followed account.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the followed account's Instagram profile.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant started following this account.

description.en: Advertisements that were shown to you on Instagram. These reveal what advertisers think they know about your interests and demographics.
description.nl: Advertenties die aan u zijn getoond op Instagram. Deze onthullen wat adverteerders denken te weten over uw interesses en demografische kenmerken.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one advertisement impression shown to the participant on Instagram. Includes the advertiser identity and when the ad was displayed.

columns.Account name: Username of the advertiser's Instagram account.
columns.Name: Display name of the advertiser.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the ad was shown to the participant.

description.en: Posts you viewed on Instagram, sorted over time. This shows how you consume content and which accounts capture your attention.
description.nl: Berichten die u op Instagram heeft bekeken, gesorteerd op tijd. Dit laat zien hoe u content consumeert en welke accounts uw aandacht trekken.

title.en: The total number of Instagram posts you viewed over time
title.nl: Het totale aantal Instagram-berichten dat je in de loop van de tijd hebt bekeken

title.en: The total number of Instagram posts you have viewed per hour of the day
title.nl: Het totale aantal Instagram-berichten dat je per uur van de dag hebt bekeken

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post that appeared in the participant's Instagram feed and was registered as viewed. Captures the author and timing of each impression.

columns.Author: Username or display name of the account that published the viewed post.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the viewed post.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was viewed.

description.en: Videos you watched on Instagram. This reveals your video consumption patterns and interests.
description.nl: Video's die u op Instagram heeft bekeken. Dit onthult uw videoconsumptiepatronen en interesses.

title.en: The total number of videos watched on Instagram over time
title.nl: Het totale aantal video's dat je op Instagram hebt bekeken in de loop van de tijd

documentation.summary: Each row represents one video (including Reels) that the participant watched on Instagram. Captures the creator and timing of each view event.

columns.Author: Username or display name of the account that published the watched video.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the watched video.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the video was watched.

description.en: Comments you left on Instagram posts. These are the conversations you participated in across the platform.
description.nl: Reacties die u heeft achtergelaten op Instagram-berichten. Dit zijn de gesprekken waaraan u heeft deelgenomen op het platform.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant posted on an Instagram post. Covers all matching comment files in the archive (e.g. post_comments.json, post_comments_1.json).

columns.Comment: The full text of the comment posted by the participant.
columns.Media owner: Username of the account that owns the post the comment was placed on.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was posted.

description.en: Comments by others that you liked on Instagram.
description.nl: Reacties van anderen die u leuk vond op Instagram.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant liked on Instagram. Comment text may be absent in newer export formats.

columns.Account name: Username of the account whose comment was liked.
columns.Value: Text of the liked comment, if available in the export (empty in newer export formats).
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was liked.

description.en: Posts that you liked on Instagram. Your likes reveal what content resonates with you.
description.nl: Berichten die u leuk vond op Instagram. Uw likes onthullen welke content bij u aanslaat.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post the participant liked on Instagram, including the account whose post was liked and when the like was given.

columns.Account name: Username of the account whose post was liked.
columns.Value: Display name or additional label for the liked post, depending on export format.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was liked.

description.en: Profiles you searched for on Instagram. This shows who you were curious about.
description.nl: Profielen die u op Instagram heeft opgezocht. Dit laat zien naar wie u nieuwsgierig was.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one profile search performed by the participant on Instagram, recording what was searched and when.

columns.Name: Username or display name that was searched for.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was performed.

description.en: Stories that you liked on Instagram.
description.nl: Stories die u leuk vond op Instagram.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one Instagram Story the participant liked, recording the account whose story was liked and when.

columns.Account name: Username of the account whose story was liked.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the story was liked.

description.en: List of Threads posts you viewed.
description.nl: Lijst van Threads-berichten die je hebt bekeken.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post on Threads (Meta's text-based social network linked to Instagram) that the participant viewed, including the author and timing.

columns.Author: Username or display name of the account that published the viewed Threads post.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the viewed Threads post.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was viewed.

description.en: List of posts you have saved on Instagram.
description.nl: Lijst van berichten die je hebt opgeslagen op Instagram.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post the participant bookmarked (saved) on Instagram for later viewing.

columns.Title: Title or label of the saved post as stored in the export.
columns.URL: Direct URL to the saved post.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was saved.
